candidate.body_excerpt: ذرائع: تلنگانہ پبلک سروس کمیشن (ٹی جی پی ایس سی) نے اے ای ای سول ریکروٹمنٹ امتحان کی تاریخ میں تبدیلی کا اعلان کیا ہے۔ Normalized fact extract from the Urdu article and official web note: TELANGANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION, Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) in Roads & Buildings Department, CBRT examination scheduled on 06/11/2026 and 07/11/2026; Staff Selection Commission (SSC) Junior Engineer (Civil) Examination, 2026 from 2nd to 6th November 2026; candidates with 06.11.2026 hall tickets may be accommodated on 07.11.2026 wherever feasible after scrutiny; SSC JE hall ticket, TGPSC AEE application and TGPSC One Time Registration (OTR) ID must be submitted to the Help Desk or helpdesk@tgpsc.gov.in before 5:00 PM on 30.10.2026.

evidence_text: TELANGANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION. ASSISTANT EXECUTIVE ENGINEERS (CIVIL) IN ROADS & BUILDINGS DEPARTMENT. NOTIFICATION NO. 01/G/RB/2026, DATED:02/06/2026. WEB NOTE. The Commission has received some representations from candidates regarding the clash between the examination for the post of Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) in the Roads and Buildings Department to be conducted by TGPSC which is scheduled on 06th/07th November 2026, and the Staff Selection Commission (SSC) Junior Engineer Examination, 2026 from 2nd to 6th November 2026. The Commission has examined the matter in detail. The Hon'ble Chairman, TGPSC, Sri Burra Venkatesham, IAS (VR), has also taken up the issue with the Chairman of the Staff Selection Commission. In this regard, the Chairman, SSC, has assured that candidates from Telangana whose examination dates clash with the TGPSC AEE (Civil) Examination, wherever feasible, would be accommodated on 04.11.2026 or 05.11.2026. However, some candidates have subsequently reported that their hall tickets for the SSC Junior Engineer (Civil) Examination, 2026, indicate 06.11.2026 as the examination date, resulting in a clash with the TGPSC AEE (Civil) Examination. In order to resolve the issue and facilitate the affected candidates in appearing for both examinations, all candidates who have been allotted 06.11.2026 for the SSC JE (Civil) Examination and have also applied for the TGPSC AEE (Civil) Examination are advised to submit the following documents: 1) A copy of the SSC JE (Civil) hall ticket indicating the examination date as 06.11.2026. 2) A copy of the application submitted for the TGPSC AEE (Civil) Notification. 3) TGPSC - One Time Registration (OTR) ID. The above documents shall be submitted through the Help Desk at the TGPSC office or by email to helpdesk@tgpsc.gov.in on or before 5:00 PM on 30.10.2026. After considering the representations received and scrutiny, with a view to ensuring that the affected candidates are not deprived of the opportunity to appear for both examinations, the Commission has decided, wherever feasible, to accommodate such candidates by scheduling their TGPSC AEE (Civil) Examination on 07.11.2026. The Commission conducts examinations through extensive logistical arrangements and the deployment of substantial resources. While remaining committed to transparency, efficiency and the timely declaration of results, the Commission also endeavours to adhere to the examination schedule announced already. The above arrangement has been made to address the genuine difficulties faced by the affected candidates while ensuring the smooth conduct of the examination process. All candidates concerned are advised to submit the requisite documents within the stipulated time to enable the Commission to make the necessary arrangements. Place: Hyderabad. Date: 26/10/2026. Sd/- SECRETARY, TGPSC.

urdu_bullets: The TGPSC AEE (Civil) exam is on 6 and 7 November 2026.
SSC JE (Civil) candidates with a 6 November clash may take the AEE exam on 7 November, wherever feasible.
Submit hall ticket, application and OTR ID by 5 PM on 30 October; scrutiny applies.
